name: Downtown Flushing pilot
description: Approximate rectangle centered on Main St and Roosevelt Ave in Flushing, Queens, about 1.4 km across, including Main St east to Parsons Blvd. The edges are approximate; check the dashed outline on the map after importing and edit these coordinates if needed. Trips must start and end inside this outline. The router also loads walkways in a 400 m buffer around it so trips near the edge can detour.
